apps.name: agentrix-backend
apps._comment_max_memory: Was 1G — too low for tool-calling + multi-agent + Bedrock streaming workloads which can spike to 1.5GB. Bumped to 4G; if even that gets exceeded the process is genuinely leaking and warrants investigation, not a silent restart loop that murders user task streams.
apps._comment_kill_timeout: Was 1600ms (PM2 default) — graceful SSE drain in main.ts needs at least 6s to walk the registry. 8000ms gives 25% headroom for the drain + app.close().

env._comment_node_options: Node default heap is ~2GB on Linux x64 (--max-old-space-size=2048 effective). Raise to 3GB so V8 can allocate before OS-killed; max_memory_restart still catches genuine leaks at 4GB.
